description: This file defines the interface for the Watchdog (WDG) module in an embedded AUTOSAR-based system. It declares function prototypes for initializing, triggering, setting modes, and retrieving version info for various watchdog types, with conditional compilation based on configuration macros.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_Init
methods.description: Initializes the independent watchdog with provided configuration.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_Trigger
methods.description: Triggers (kicks) the independent watchdog to prevent reset.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the independent watchdog.

methods.name: Wdg_IWDG_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information for the independent watchdog module.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_Init
methods.description: Initializes the window watchdog with the specified configuration.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the window watchdog.

methods.name: Wdg_WWDG_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information for the window watchdog module.

methods.name: Wdg_Init
methods.description: Initializes the generic watchdog with provided configuration.

methods.name: Wdg_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the watchdog.

methods.name: Wdg_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information for the watchdog module.
